layer_set: ALL 21 layers of the bundled topology arch/bundled/topologies/conv_nets/Resnet18.csv (real layers, no hand-picked synthetic set); conv->GEMM mapping as in SCALE-Sim topology_utils (ofmap = ceil((H-Fh+s)/s)).

machine.array: 128x128 (cost-driven: 32x32 needs ~15 min per run, 12 runs x 2 reruns does not fit the queue; 128x128 ~6 min)
machine.base_config: bundled arch/bundled/configs/scale.cfg (SRAM 64 kB per buffer, ReadRequestBuffer 32) with only ArrayHeight/Width, Dataflow and the interface-bandwidth keys overridden

intensity: AI = 2*M*N*K / (unique ifmap tensor + filter + ofmap bytes), compulsory traffic, 1 byte/word (SCALE-Sim hard-codes word_size=1)

A_user_bandwidth_stalls.keys: InterfaceBandwidth=USER; Bandwidth = IfmapSRAMBankBandwidth = FilterSRAMBankBandwidth = B; IfmapSRAMBankNum = FilterSRAMBankNum = 1 (single_layer_sim.py takes the ifmap/filter DRAM-side bandwidth from the *SRAMBankBandwidth keys and the ofmap bandwidth from Bandwidth; read_buffer.py asserts bank_bandwidth*num_bank == total)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.B_justification: Fixed from the layer arithmetic-intensity distribution alone (min 2.0, median ~250, max ~597 FLOP/B) before any run: peak = 2*128*128 = 32768 FLOP/cycle, ridge = peak/B = 2048 (low: every layer below the ridge), 512 (mid: nearly all below), 128 (high: roughly half above).
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.signal: stall_frac = Stall Cycles / Total Cycles per layer (COMPUTE_REPORT.csv)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.per_dataflow_pass: Spearman rho(AI, stall_frac) <= -0.6 at >= 2 of the 3 bandwidth levels AND rho < +0.3 at all 3 levels. A (dataflow, B) cell with fewer than 5 layers having stall_frac > 0 is uninformative and counts as NOT satisfying rho <= -0.6.
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.knob_sanity: per dataflow, total stall cycles over the 21 layers are non-increasing as B goes low -> mid -> high

B_calc_bandwidth_mode.keys: bundled scale.cfg unchanged: InterfaceBandwidth=CALC (SCALE-Sim computes the DRAM bandwidth each layer needs; no limit enforced)
B_calc_bandwidth_mode.signal: required_bw = Avg IFMAP DRAM BW + Avg FILTER DRAM BW + Avg OFMAP DRAM BW (BANDWIDTH_REPORT.csv, words/cycle)

overall_pass: A passes for all 3 dataflows AND knob_sanity holds for all 3 AND B passes for all 3 dataflows AND two complete reruns are byte-identical. Thresholds are final; they are not revisited after seeing results. A failure is reported as FAIL with a diagnosis.
supplementary_not_gating: stall_frac vs effective intensity (DRAM words actually moved)
rho at each B and dataflow
ratio simulated ifmap DRAM reads / ifmap tensor size
superseded_part1_criteria: Part 1 gates (classification agreement >= 80 % and rho(AI_eff, stall_frac) <= -0.5 on 16 hand-picked synthetic GEMMs, 16x16 array, B=4) are kept in the summary under 'superseded' with their original numbers.
